name: Brødrene A & O Johansen A/S
summary: Brødrene A & O Johansen A/S, together with its subsidiaries, functions as a supplier and distributor of technical installation materials and tools throughout Denmark, Sweden, and Norway. The company manages its business across two main divisions: Professional B2B, which targets business clients, and Private B2C, serving individual consumers. Its extensive product offering includes plumbing, heating, and sanitary fittings; electrical equipment and components; and items and tools for water supply and drainage. Additionally, they provide various fastening materials such as brackets, workwear, safety gear, and locking systems. The diverse clientele encompasses tradespeople like plumbers, carpenters, and electricians, alongside building and sewer contractors, construction firms, municipal bodies, utility companies, and public sector organizations. Brødrene A & O Johansen A/S conducts sales through physical retail outlets in Denmark and a robust online presence via numerous e-commerce sites, including BilligVVS.dk, LavprisVVS.dk, VVSochBad.se, BilligVVS.no, Greenline.dk, LavprisEL.dk, LampeGuru.dk, Lampeguru.no, CompletVVS.dk, and LavprisVærktøj.dk. Established in 1914, the company's headquarters are situated in Albertslund, Denmark.
